notes: Windows are whole-month ranges: a sowing window of 05-01 to 06-30 means the source records peak sowing in May-June, not exact calendar days.
Entries are grouped: districts that share an identical window in the source share one C- id.
Chennai and Mayiladuthurai have no rows in Table X (Chennai is urban; Mayiladuthurai was formed in 2020 after the table's data year), so no window is claimed for them.
Cross-check: for Cuddalore and Coimbatore groundnut and sesame the TN Table X windows match the PMFBY district crop calendar exactly.

Paddy seasons keep their Tamil Nadu names (kuruvai/kar/sornavari, samba/thaladi/pishanam, navarai/kodai). For other crops the season group is derived from the sowing month: Jun-Sep kharif, Oct-Jan rabi, Feb-May summer.
